FROM (

properties.note: The ruling description text lives in rulings.text and is linked to the card by the shared uuid value (cards.uuid = rulings.uuid).

properties.note: Both subtype and supertype lists are frequently NULL, so type listings should exclude rows where either is missing.
properties.sql: cards.subtypes IS NOT NULL AND cards.supertypes IS NOT NULL

properties.note: Border style is stored as a lowercase color code in cards.borderColor, whose values include 'borderless'.
properties.sql: cards.borderColor = 'borderless'

properties.note: set_translations rows are keyed to the parent set by the shared set id column, so a set's translation rows are found with sets.id = set_translations.id rather than any setCode/code pairing.
properties.sql: sets.id = set_translations.id

properties.note: A positive hand-size modifier is a cards.hand value that has no leading minus sign and is not the neutral '0', since the stored text carries the sign as part of the value.
properties.sql: cards.hand NOT LIKE '-%' AND cards.hand <> '0'

properties.note: cards.type holds the visible type with supertypes and subtypes (e.g. Artifact, Creature, Instant).
properties.sql: cards.type

properties.note: In this database a card links to the set's translation rows through set_translations.id, which identifies the set rather than by joining on the set code.
properties.sql: cards.id = set_translations.id

properties.note: Sets that are available only outside the US are flagged with sets.isForeignOnly = 1 (an integer boolean flag).
properties.sql: sets.isForeignOnly = 1

properties.note: When a question asks which card/what the card is, the answer is the card's name from cards.name, not its internal id.
properties.sql: cards.name

properties.note: Compute a row percentage by counting matching rows with a conditional SUM divided by the total row count, multiplying by 100.
properties.sql: 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN cards.isOnlineOnly = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(cards.id)
